abilities.name: Sidearm
abilities.text: Projectile, range 6. 2 kinetic damage to the first unit hit.

abilities.name: Grapple Hook
abilities.text: Range 5, along a line of sight. Pull self: travel toward the tile and stop on the last free tile before a blocker. Pull unit: drag the first unit hit until it is adjacent to you. Cannot pull the Warden.

abilities.name: Proximity Mine
abilities.text: Place on an empty tile within 3. Any ground unit entering it, friend or foe, sets it off: 3 explosive damage to its tile and the 8 neighbours. At most 4 mines. Pick Up (1 AP, adjacent) removes one.

abilities.name: Auto-Turret
abilities.text: Place on an empty tile within 2. Minion, 4 HP, 4 ammo. Shoots the nearest enemy within 5 for 2 kinetic. Reload costs 1 AP.

abilities.name: Scout Drone
abilities.text: Spawns adjacent to you. Flying minion, 3 HP, 2 charges. Zaps the nearest enemy within 2 for 1 electric, chaining 1 to every unit adjacent to it. Flies home when empty; Redeploy costs 1 AP.

abilities.name: Barrier Shield
abilities.text: Two adjacent empty tiles within 4. Two segments of 4 HP that block movement and projectiles, not sight. At most 2 placements.

abilities.name: Acid Spit
abilities.text: Projectile, range 5. 1 acid damage and 2 Corrode stacks to the first unit hit. Each stack removes 1 armor for the rest of the fight.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.text: Leap up to 3 tiles in a straight orthogonal line, over units but not pillars, walls or shields, onto a free tile. Then you may hit one adjacent unit for 2 kinetic.

abilities.name: Spore Pod
abilities.text: Lob, range 5. Poisons every unit in a 3x3 area, friend or foe: 1 damage a round for 3 rounds, spreading to up to 3 neighbours a round.

abilities.name: Brood Egg
abilities.text: An empty tile or enemy corpse within 3. Floor: 2 hatchlings in 1 round. Guard corpse: a spitter in 2 rounds. Flamer corpse: a burster in 2 rounds. The egg has 3 HP.

abilities.name: Parasite
abilities.text: Projectile, range 5. The first unit hit takes 2 damage a round for 3 rounds. If it dies, a hatchling bursts out.

utilities.name: Redeploy
utilities.text: Place a docked drone adjacent to you with full charges.
